liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes of the World** (5 reviews): Eyes of the World is described as heavily jammed out; Reviewer calls this the best Eyes of the World they have ever witnessed [14][15][16][21][22]
- **Friend of the Devil** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out Bruce's contribution to this Friend of the Devil as a standout, one of their all-time favorites; Bruce's playing on Friend of the Devil is described as dreamy [14][15]
- **Samson and Delilah** (1 review): Samson and Delilah is said to have rocked the house down [25]

## Setlist highlights

- **Blues for Allah**: back after 1129 archived shows (5709 days); rare: 7 archived performances [26]
- **Stronger Than Dirt**: back after 1099 archived shows (5371 days); rare: 10 archived performances [26]
- **Stronger Than Dirt**: back after 1099 archived shows (5371 days); rare: 10 archived performances [26]
- **Blues for Allah**: back after 1129 archived shows (5709 days); rare: 7 archived performances [26]
- **Radio Announcers**: rare: 5 archived performances [26]

## The recordings

- **gd91-03-31.sbd.perkins.9451.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 195 min; rated 4.54/5 by 26 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds both performance and recording quality excellent, though there are a few glitches listed in the text file; There is digital noise or clipping at the start of Friend of the Devil, plus a quick skip; Mix early on buries Jerry's guitar, while Bobby's guitar and Vince's keyboards sit well forward [20][23]
- **gd1991-03-31.mtx.south.99386.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 16 songs; 159 min; rated 2.83/5 by 6 [4]
- **gd1991-03-31.154477.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 157 min [5]
- **gd1991-03-31.152200.miller.pearson.healy.flac2496**: soundboard; 16 songs; 157 min [6]

## Around the show

- It was Easter Sunday, and the setlist was all older material, with Queen Jane Approximately the newest song [16]
- Hornsby's first show back after missing the Knickerbocker and Nassau runs in March 1991; Jerry seemed excited to have him [20]
- Bruce's keyboard playing added a new dimension, recalling the sound Keith brought in the 1970s [21]
- With Bruce sitting in, Jerry watched him with a glint in his eye, apparently energized by new players [22]
- During Eyes, and the next night's Darkstar, the reviewer's friend collapsed backward from the music's intensity [25]
- Reviewer rates this the best stop of the spring 1991 tour and recommends the next night's show too [14]
- Reviewer had heard the early-1970s Louisville, KY Eyes was best; says this one rivals it [22]
- Reviewer finds the audience recording of this show gives more chills than the soundboard [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-03-31.sbd.perkins.9451.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > ?? > EAC > Multiquence > Shn [1]. Also: Filler on this source comes from the 3-23-75 show; Samson and Delilah into Eyes of the World appear as bonus tracks on disc 3 of Dick's Picks 17; Samson and Eyes of the World from this show appear on Dick's Picks 17; text file notes flaws [1][19][21]
- **gd1991-03-31.mtx.south.99386.flac16**: transferred by Joey South; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [4]. Also: Audience recording from front of board, taper unknown, using Schoeps CMC34 microphones in ORTF into a Panasonic SV255 DAT; Transfer from a DAT clone via Tascam DA-20 and Lynx interface, edited in Wavelab, then dithered to 16-bit 44.1kHz FLAC [4]
- **gd1991-03-31.154477.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 5, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [5]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; multiple masters combined to make the show complete; Songs from this date are on Dick's Picks 17; this version is converted from a 24-bit 96kHz source to 16-bit [5]
- **gd1991-03-31.152200.miller.pearson.healy.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 5, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [6]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; multiple masters combined to make the show complete [6]
